Written by
Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®

Willoughby is close to home for me. I grew up on a farm in Langley and I live in Langley again now. With a Willoughby half duplex I check the plan, the title and the suite permits before you write an offer. I've been a REALTOR® since 2015, I'm in the top 1% of Fraser Valley Realtors, and I have more than $500M in sales.

This page shows duplexes and half duplexes for sale in Willoughby, which Paragon, the MLS® system local REALTORS® use, files as the Willoughby Heights sub-area of Langley. A half duplex is one side of a building split into two homes. You own your side and share one wall with the neighbour. Willoughby is in the Township of Langley, not the City of Langley, so the Township's zoning bylaw and plans are the ones that apply.
Willoughby has been built out in stages under neighbourhood plans, so newer streets and smaller lots can sit next to land that hasn't been developed yet. For schools, parks and shopping, read my
Willoughby guide
The Township guides Willoughby through a community plan and a set of neighbourhood-level plans. The Township has replaced the old Willoughby Community Plan and created two new plans:
the Willoughby Transit Corridor Plan, which takes in the former Carvolth, Latimer, Jericho, Routley and South West Gordon Estate areas along the 200 Street corridor
the Gordon Neighbourhood Plan, which takes in the former Central Gordon Estate and North East Gordon Estate areas

The Yorkson, Smith and Williams Neighbourhood Plans stay in place on their own. The Township says applications made before the change can still proceed under the old plans for a transition period, so two sets of rules can apply side by side for a while. If a half duplex backs onto undeveloped land, ask which plan covers that land and what it's designated for.

In Willoughby, a duplex is a single building with two homes. The Township of Langley also uses the term semi-detached dwelling for a duplex building that sits across two lots, with the lot line running down the shared wall. Either way, MLS lists each side on its own, which is why you'll see "half duplex" on this page.

In Willoughby, a half duplex is owned in one of two ways. In a two-lot strata, there's a strata corporation, bylaws and a Form B, even with only one neighbour. In a semi-detached setup, each side is its own legal lot with no strata. Get the title, and the strata plan if there is one, at the start. It tells you who looks after the roof, the shared wall and the yard.
The Township lets eligible lots have small-scale multi-unit housing. A lot qualifies only if it:
is within the Urban Containment Boundary
has both municipal water and sewer
isn't heritage-designated by bylaw
is outside the Transit Oriented Area
is no bigger than 4,050 m² (1 acre)

If it qualifies, a lot of 280 m² or less can have 3 units, and a lot from 280 m² to 4,050 m² can have 4. A lot that doesn't qualify is limited to one home plus a secondary suite or accessory dwelling unit, depending on its zone. Parking and servicing rules still apply, so ask the Township before you plan on more units.

The Township allows a secondary suite in a duplex or a semi-detached dwelling. You'll need a building permit, confirmed parking and, if it's a strata, the strata's OK. The BC Building Code allows one secondary suite per home. If a listing mentions a suite, ask for the permit.

The Township has one Transit Oriented Area, the 800 m radius around the planned Willowbrook SkyTrain station on 196 Street, at the west edge of Willoughby. Inside it, the small-scale housing rules above don't apply, and the Province sets minimum allowable heights and densities instead. If a listing is near 196 Street, check whether it falls inside that radius.

blocks.text: What is a half duplex in Willoughby?

parts.t: It's one side of a building that holds two homes. You own your side, and one wall is shared with your neighbour.

blocks.text: Is Willoughby in the City of Langley?

parts.t: No. Willoughby is in the Township of Langley, so the Township's zoning bylaw and plans apply. Paragon files it as Willoughby Heights.

blocks.text: Does a Willoughby half duplex come with a strata?

parts.t: Some do, as a two-lot strata. Others are semi-detached homes, with each side on its own legal lot and no strata.

blocks.text: Are suites allowed in Willoughby duplexes?

parts.t: Yes, with a building permit, confirmed parking and strata approval where needed. The building code allows one suite per home.

blocks.text: How many units can an eligible Township lot have?

parts.t: 3 units on lots of 280 m² or less, and 4 units on lots from 280 m² up to 4,050 m².
A new Willoughby Community Plan, the Willoughby Transit Corridor Plan, the Gordon Neighbourhood Plan, and the Yorkson, Smith and Williams Neighbourhood Plans.

blocks.text: What is the Willowbrook Transit Oriented Area?

parts.t: The 800 m radius around the planned Willowbrook SkyTrain station on 196 Street. The small-scale housing rules don't apply inside it.
